en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 新增 Qwen Code、Kimi Code、CodeBuddy、Qoder、GitHub Copilot 和 ZCode，接入聊天、群聊及工作流；Qoder 使用全局模式，其余五种也支持独立配置模型 (#3280)
- Ekko 会话在历史和搜索中归入内置 Agent，并支持 /context、/usage、/status 和 /compact 命令 (#3276)
- 新建聊天默认选择 Ekko，直接展示已安装 Agent，避免 CLI 探测；重新打开未发送的聊天不再等待不存在的历史消息 (#3284、#3288)
- 完善编程 Agent 按原生能力传递图片输入，并支持 Windows 下的长文本和多行提示词 (#3285)
- 完善 Windows Agent 运行依赖检查和 ZCode 桌面 CLI 识别，修复含空格或非 ASCII 字符路径的启动问题 (#3281)
- 修复 Copilot 通过 Responses API 流式调用工具时参数不完整的问题，并补齐 custom 工具兼容性，解决 GPT 模型发送图片时返回 400 Unsupported Chat Completions tool: custom 的问题 (#3286、#3289)
- 修复 Claude 在 root 环境中的免确认工具执行，并统一全局和独立模式启动权限 (#3287)
- 移除已停用的 OpenCode Free 供应商及其模型入口 (#3277)
- 前端 changelog 仅保留最近三个版本，清理更早版本的更新记录及全部对应国际化文本 (#3289)
What's Changed
- feat(studio): introduce built-in Ekko chats and agent catalog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3276
- [codex] remove retired OpenCode Free provider by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3277
- [codex] add six native coding agents with scoped model support by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3280
- [codex] default chats to Ekko and avoid CLI probes during creation by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3284
- [codex] support coding agent images and Windows long prompts by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3285
- [refactor] isolate coding agents and harden Windows launches by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3281
- [codex] fix Copilot streamed tool argument JSON by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3286
- fix(coding-agents): launch Claude with IS_SANDBOX permission bypass by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3287
- [codex] avoid history loading for unsent chats by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3288
- [codex] release 0.7.30 and fix Copilot custom tool requests by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3289
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/compare/v0.7.29...v0.7.30
